claims.statement: TAURON's official microinstallation process requires storage-specific data attachments in relevant configurations and publishes versioned connection documents.

contrary_evidence: TAURON already provides an online form designed to reduce errors, so a single-DSO form wrapper has weak value.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: a consented corpus of form versions, accepted configurations, and correction reasons improves rules by DSO and installation type
fingerprint.customer: Polish PV and battery installers handling recurring DSO paperwork
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: family-business proof, wholesaler integrations, and white-label installation CRMs
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: form compiler, document validation, equipment-data reuse, amendment tracking, and correction-response workflow
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the installer pays when the DSO-facing package passes the compiler's completeness warranty and is submitted
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a sold installation is ready for grid notification or an existing microinstallation is expanded with storage

founder_fit: Exceptional family-business validation access and strong automation fit; can be tested part-time on real authorized jobs without impersonation.
risks: The tool could be blamed for rejection even when grid constraints, not paperwork, are decisive.

structure.control_point: the installer-ready evidence bundle immediately before a microinstallation or storage connection notification reaches the DSO
structure.critical_dependency: continuous mapping of DSO form versions and lawful capture of completeness outcomes and correction reasons

thesis: Compile equipment data, diagrams, declarations, powers of attorney, and DSO-specific forms into a completeness-checked connection notification for PV-plus-storage installers. Charge at the first objective milestone: a submission accepted as complete, not at lead generation. All commercial numbers, including capital_required_pln, are unvalidated hypotheses.
title: Storage-Aware Grid Submission Compiler for Polish Installers
uncertainties: Correction frequency and installer willingness to pay are unvalidated.
Expansion effort across DSOs is unknown.
